Audio Fade In/Out

Add smooth fade-in and fade-out to any audio track and export as WAV.

🎚️ Drop an audio file here or click to browse
0:00
Duration

Files never leave your device — everything is processed in your browser.

📖 How to use

  1. Drop an audio file into the tool.
  2. Set the fade-in and fade-out lengths in seconds.
  3. Preview, then click Download WAV.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How are the fades applied?

Linear gain envelopes are applied over the fade durations you set, at the sample level.

Can I preview before downloading?

Yes — press Preview to hear the faded result before downloading.

What format is the download?

A 16-bit PCM WAV.
